items.title: Section: The Ground of the Bodhisattva Opens — Ten Topics Spanning the Entire Path to Buddhahood

items.zh: 如是已說獨覺地。云何菩薩地？嗢拕南曰：初持、次相、分、增上意樂、住、生、攝受、地、行、建立最為後。有十法具攝大乘菩薩道及果。何等為十？一者、持，二者、相，三者、分，四者、增上意樂，五者、住，六者、生，七者、攝受，八者、地，九者、行，十者、建立。
items.en: The Ground of the Solitary Buddha has now been fully explained. What is the Ground of the Bodhisattva? … Summary verse: retention first, then marks, and portions; strengthened resolve, then abidings; birth, embracing, grounds, and conduct; establishment comes very last. Ten topics together comprise the great vehicle's bodhisattva path and its fruit. What are the ten? First, retention; second, marks; third, portions; fourth, strengthened resolve; fifth, abidings; sixth, birth; seventh, embracing; eighth, grounds; ninth, conduct; tenth, establishment.

items.title: What "Retention" Actually Means — Three Supports Carrying a Being All the Way to Buddhahood

items.zh: 云何名持？謂諸菩薩自乘種姓、最初發心，及以一切菩提分法，是名為持。何以故？
items.en: What is called retention? A bodhisattva's own lineage, the initial arising of the resolve, and every factor of awakening practised — these together are called retention.

items.zh: 以諸菩薩自乘種姓為所依止故、為建立故，有所堪任、有大勢力，能證無上正等菩提，是故說彼自乘種姓，為諸菩薩堪任性持。以
items.en: Because a bodhisattva's own lineage serves as the basis and the foundation, one has the capacity and the great strength to attain unsurpassed, perfect awakening — for this reason, that lineage is called the retention of capacity for all bodhisattvas.

items.title: Section: Two Kinds of Lineage — Innate and Cultivated, and Why Some Beings Can Never Become Buddhas

items.zh: 諸菩薩最初發心為所依止、為建立故，於施、戒、忍、精進、靜慮、慧，於六波羅蜜多，於福德資糧、智慧資糧，於一切菩提分法，能勤修學，是故說彼最初發心，為諸菩薩行加行持。以諸菩薩一切所行菩提分法為所依止、為建立故，圓滿無上正等菩提。是故說彼一切所行菩提分法，為所
items.en: What is lineage? In brief, there are two kinds: the lineage abiding by nature, and the lineage accomplished through habituation. The lineage abiding by nature is this: bodhisattvas possess a distinctive quality in their six sense-faculties, carried forward from beginningless time, naturally so without contrivance — this is called the lineage abiding by nature. The lineage accomplished through habituation is that obtained through previously cultivated wholesome roots — this is called the lineage accomplished through habituation. Here, both kinds are intended together.

items.zh: 住無種姓補特伽羅，無種姓故，雖有發心及行加行為所依止，定不堪任圓滿無上正等菩提。由此道理，雖未發心、未修菩薩所行加行，若有種姓，當知望彼而得名持。
items.en: A person abiding with no lineage at all, precisely because of lacking that lineage, even should such a person generate the resolve and undertake bodhisattva practices as a basis, will definitely never be capable of perfecting unsurpassed, perfect awakening. By this same reasoning, even one who has not yet generated the resolve nor cultivated bodhisattva practices, if possessed of the lineage, should be understood — by comparison with such a person — to already have retention.

items.zh: 又住種姓補特伽羅，若不發心、不修菩薩所行加行，雖有堪任，而不速證無上菩提；與此相違，當知速證。又此種姓，已說名持，亦名為助、亦名為因、亦名為依、亦名階級、亦名前導、亦名舍宅。如說種姓，最初發心、所行加行，應知亦爾。云何種姓？謂略有二種。一、本性住種姓，二、習所成種姓。本性住種姓者，謂諸菩薩六處殊勝有如是相，從無始世展轉傳來，法爾所得，是名本性住種姓。習所成種姓者，謂先串習善根所得，是名習所成種姓。此中義意，二種皆取。又此種姓亦名種子、亦名為界、亦名為性。又此種姓未習成果，說名為細，未有果故。已習成果，說名為麁，與果俱故。若諸菩薩成就種姓，尚過一切聲聞、獨覺，何況其餘一切有情。當知種姓無上最勝。何以故？

items.title: Section: Why Bodhisattva Lineage Surpasses Every Other — Two Purifications, Four Comparisons

items.zh: 略有二種淨，一、煩惱障淨，二、所知障淨。一切聲聞、獨覺種姓，唯能當證煩惱障淨，不能當證所知障淨；菩薩種姓，亦能當證煩惱障淨，亦能當證所知障淨。
items.en: There are, in brief, two kinds of purification: purification from the afflictive obstruction, and purification from the cognitive obstruction. Every hearer and solitary-buddha lineage is able only to attain purification from the afflictive obstruction, never purification from the cognitive obstruction; the bodhisattva lineage is able to attain both — purification from the afflictive obstruction, and purification from the cognitive obstruction as well.

items.zh: 是故說言望彼一切無上最勝。

復由四事，當知菩薩勝於一切聲聞、獨覺。何等為四？一者、根勝，二者、行勝，三者、善巧勝，四者、果勝。言根勝者，謂諸菩薩本性利根，獨覺中根，聲聞軟根，是名根勝。言行勝者，謂諸菩薩亦能自利，亦能利他，利益安樂無量眾生，哀愍世間，令諸天人獲得勝義利益安樂；聲聞、獨覺唯行自利；是名行勝。善巧勝者，聲聞、獨覺於蘊、界、處、緣起、處非處中能修善巧；菩薩於此及於其餘一切明處能修善巧；是名善巧勝。言果勝者，聲聞能證聲聞菩提，獨覺能證獨覺菩提，菩薩、能證阿耨多羅三藐三菩提，
items.en: Further, by four measures, one should know a bodhisattva surpasses every hearer and solitary buddha. What are the four? First, superiority of faculty; second, of conduct; third, of skillfulness; fourth, of fruit. Superiority of faculty: bodhisattvas are by nature sharp-facultied, solitary buddhas middling, hearers dull … superiority of conduct: bodhisattvas are able to benefit both themselves and others … superiority of skillfulness: hearers and solitary buddhas cultivate skillfulness only in the aggregates, elements, sense-bases, dependent origination, and what is possible and impossible; bodhisattvas cultivate skillfulness in these and in every other field of knowledge besides … superiority of fruit: a hearer attains a hearer's awakening, a solitary buddha a solitary buddha's awakening, but a bodhisattva attains unsurpassed, perfect, complete awakening.

items.zh: 是名果勝。又諸菩薩有六波羅蜜多種姓相。由此相故，令他了知真是菩薩。謂施波羅蜜多種姓相，戒、忍、精進、靜慮、慧波羅蜜多種姓相。云何菩薩施波羅蜜多種姓相？

blocks.text: Today begins the fifteenth stage, the **Bodhisattva Stage** (菩薩地), fascicles 35–50: the treatise's full account of the Mahāyāna path, and among the most influential parts of the whole treatise (its chapter on moral discipline became a standard source for the bodhisattva vows, especially in Tibet). A passage (0478c05) is untranslated.

The whole stage is organised under ten topics: retention, marks, portions, strengthened resolve, abidings, birth, embracing, grounds, conduct, and establishment. "Ten topics together comprise the great vehicle's bodhisattva path and its fruit." Master Cháng Bǎi: the "grounds" here are the ten bodhisattva grounds, set out as seven.

"A bodhisattva's own lineage, the initial arising of the resolve, and every factor of awakening practised: these together are called retention (持)." The lineage is "the retention of capacity"; the resolve and the practices carry one to Buddhahood.
"A person with no lineage, even should he raise the resolve and undertake bodhisattva practice, will definitely never perfect unsurpassed awakening."

One with the lineage who does not raise the resolve and practise "has the capacity, but does not swiftly attain awakening". Lineage is also called support, cause, basis, stage, forerunner, dwelling. It is of two kinds: **naturally abiding** (本性住種姓), "a distinctive feature of the six sense bases, carried from beginningless time, naturally so", and **accomplished through habituation** (習所成種姓), gained from wholesome roots cultivated before. Both are meant here. Before bearing fruit it is "subtle", after, "coarse" (as on Day 176). It surpasses every hearer and solitary buddha.

Two purifications: from the **afflictive obstruction** and from the **cognitive obstruction** (所知障). Hearers and solitary buddhas attain only the first; bodhisattvas both. Venerable Miào Jìng: the cognitive obstruction is a kind of not-knowing. Four further superiorities: of faculty (bodhisattvas sharp, solitary buddhas middling, hearers dull), of conduct, of skill, and of fruit.

quiz.q: "Ten topics comprise the great vehicle's bodhisattva path and its fruit." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain "path and fruit"?
options: the path is the cause — cause and fruit are wholly included in these ten
quiz.why: "Ten topics together comprise the great vehicle's bodhisattva path and its fruit." Venerable Miào Jìng: in "bodhisattva path," path means cause; the cause and the fruit are fully included in these ten.

quiz.q: The eighth topic, "grounds" — what does it cover, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: the ten bodhisattva grounds organised as seven
quiz.why: "Eighth, grounds." Master Cháng Bǎi: grounds — the ten bodhisattva grounds are set out as seven.

quiz.q: "One's lineage, the initial resolve, and every factor of awakening — these are retention." How does Master Cháng Bǎi sum up?
options: all three retentions are indispensable conditions for awakening
quiz.why: "What is called retention? A bodhisattva's own lineage, the initial arising of the resolve, and every factor of awakening practised — these together are called retention." Master Cháng Bǎi: the bodhisattva's three — retention by lineage, by resolve, and by the factors of awakening — are all indispensable conditions for unsurpassed awakening.

quiz.q: The 住 in "lineage abiding by nature" — how does Venerable Miào Jìng explain it?
options: 住 means "having" — one's nature has uncontaminated buddha-nature
quiz.why: "The lineage abiding by nature, and the lineage accomplished through habituation." Venerable Miào Jìng: 住 means "to have" — within your nature there's an uncontaminated buddha-nature.

quiz.q: Natural lineage is "naturally so (法爾所得)." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain?
options: not created by you — originally present
quiz.why: "Carried forward from beginningless time, naturally so without contrivance." Venerable Miào Jìng: it's not something you created — this buddha-nature is originally there.

quiz.q: Hearers and solitary buddhas attain only purification from afflictive obstruction. What does Venerable Miào Jìng say of the arhat?
options: craving and view are purified, but much remains unknown
quiz.why: "Every hearer and solitary-buddha lineage is able only to attain purification from the afflictive obstruction, never purification from the cognitive obstruction." Venerable Miào Jìng: you've become an arhat, the afflictions of craving and view are purified — but there's still much you don't know.

quiz.q: "Bodhisattvas sharp, solitary buddhas middling, hearers dull." How does Master Cháng Bǎi measure sharpness?
options: the longer the path to achievement, the sharper
quiz.why: "Superiority of faculty: bodhisattvas are by nature sharp-facultied, solitary buddhas middling, hearers dull." Master Cháng Bǎi: the one who takes longest to achieve it is the sharp one.
